dependency_routes.title: Module prerequisites for Wedderburn–Artin
dependency_routes.scope: Schur’s lemma and complete reducibility for arbitrary unital modules, with finite-length arguments where explicitly required.

dependency_routes.title: Regular trace and reduced trace
dependency_routes.scope: The regular-trace criterion is stated in characteristic zero. The positive-characteristic matrix example explains why reduced trace is a different invariant; it is not a characteristic-zero restriction on Brauer groups.

readings.label: Regular trace and its positive-characteristic limitation

dependency_routes.title: Continuous Hilbert 90
dependency_routes.scope: Further reading for the profinite continuation: every field, continuous cocycles, and discrete separable-closure coefficients. The finite-extension descent results do not require this continuation as an extra hypothesis.

dependency_routes.title: Prime spectra and dimension inputs
dependency_routes.scope: Prime separation, radicals, localization and minimal primes hold without a Noetherian hypothesis. Finite irreducible decomposition is stated with its Noetherian-topology condition. Polynomial dimension and normalization here concern algebras over a field.

readings.label: Minimal primes and finite irreducible decomposition

dependency_routes.title: Hilbert-Samuel growth, local dimension and completion
dependency_routes.scope: For finite modules over Noetherian local rings and ideals of definition, the associated graded construction gives eventual polynomial growth. Artin-Rees gives top-coefficient additivity, not additivity of whole polynomials. Local dimension is identified in its separate theorem before use for completion.

readings.label: Hilbert-Samuel existence and generator bound, Theorem 4.2
Degree and top-coefficient exact-sequence formula, Theorem 6.1

dependency_routes.title: Finite prime avoidance and prime filtrations
dependency_routes.scope: Finite prime avoidance supplies parameters over every residue field. A finite module over a Noetherian ring admits a finite prime filtration; filtration primes need not all be associated to the whole module. These are the stated inputs of local ring and module dimension.

readings.label: Prime filtration and associated-prime finiteness, Theorem 2.2
Associated-prime existence and zero divisors, Theorem 1.2
Minimal primes and finite irreducible decomposition

dependency_routes.title: Affine modules and pullback
dependency_routes.scope: For any ring, modules and quasi-coherent sheaves on its spectrum are equivalent. Along an arbitrary morphism, pullback on compatible affine opens is extension of scalars. No Noetherian or finite-generation hypothesis is imposed; the separate pushforward statement has its own hypotheses.

dependency_routes.title: Galois algebra, primary components and Sylow subgroups
dependency_routes.scope: Finite separable extensions in arbitrary characteristic, closed subgroups of Galois groups, primary decomposition of arbitrary torsion modules, split finite field algebras and Sylow quotient images. The tensor calculation uses the stated finite Galois splitting field itself.

readings.label: Profinite groups and infinite Galois theory, Section 0
Extensions of complete valued fields, Proposition 0.1
Hensel's lemma, squares and roots of unity, Lemma 4.0
Integrality of characters and Burnside's theorem, Lemma 4.2
Profinite groups and infinite Galois theory, Section 0

dependency_routes.title: Finite extensions of the complex Laurent-series field
dependency_routes.scope: Finite separable normalization over a Noetherian normal domain, simple-root lifting in complete local rings, local factors of a finite algebra over a henselian ring, dimension under integral inclusion, the one-dimensional normal local DVR criterion, and completeness of finite modules. These apply to the displayed integral closure over C[[t]].

readings.label: Henselian local rings and henselization, Theorem 2.2

dependency_routes.title: Geometry and coherent finiteness for torsion on curves
dependency_routes.scope: Finite normalization, the separated quasi-finite factorization and coherent cohomology under proper morphisms. Projective finiteness and vanishing supply the stated preceding coherent input; the curve cohomology arguments themselves remain in the course.

readings.label: Coherence of higher direct images, Theorem 4.1
Serre's projective finiteness and vanishing, Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.3

dependency_routes.title: Proper geometry and henselian comparison
dependency_routes.scope: General Stein factorization, proper approximation over an arbitrary base, coherent formal existence and the full finite-type Chow construction support the geometric reductions in proper base change.

readings.label: Proper approximation, Appendix A.4.1 and A.4.2
Chow's lemma over a qcqs base, Theorem 5.1
Henselian-pair idempotents and étale lifting, Lemmas 5.3 and 5.4
